title: Pmo (escritório de projetos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Pmo (escritório de projetos) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Sobre o net Lex
O net Lex surgiu para revolucionar o mercado de Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), fazendo fluir o trabalho de todos que lidam com documentos. Acreditamos que a experiência deve ser a mais agradável possível e, por que não, divertida?!
Para alcançarmos nosso objetivo, usamos tecnologia para otimizar os processos de formalização e gestão de documentos e, ao fazermos isso, conseguimos extrair mais dados e gerar inteligência. Assim, nossos clientes ( os maiores da América Latina) podem alcançar um novo patamar de excelência e ter acesso a uma série de informações estratégicas para os ajudar a tomar decisões melhores.
Estamos crescendo os nossos times buscando novos talentos que queiram transformar o mundo da gestão do ciclo de vida de documentos com soluções inovadoras. Aqui na net Lex temos uma cultura bem forte, que se baseia em um ambiente colaborativo e descontraído para nossos net Lecos e net Lecas!
Valorizamos a diversidade e são muito bem-vindas candidaturas de pessoas pretas, mulheres, PCD, indígenas, LGBTQIA+ ou outros grupos minorizados
Sobre a oportunidade:
Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da net Lex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.
Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades como PMO por aqui?
Governança e Padronização
- Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização. - Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto. - Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos. - Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento). - Reportar o status consolidado de todas as iniciativas para a alta liderança por meio de dashboards e relatórios executivos.
Gestão de Recursos e Riscos
- Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos. - Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos. - Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos.
Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura
- Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado. - Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura. - Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.
Para que você seja considerado(a) para a posição, é necessário apresentar:
- Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner). - Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais). - Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level. - Experiência em sistemas no modelo Saa S. - Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall). - Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project). - Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados — transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto. - Vivência em Change Management: análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação. - Ensino superior completo.
Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:
- Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam). - Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares). - Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.
O que oferecemos:
Modelo Remote First: trabalhe de onde quiser de forma remota, mas caso queira, poderá visitar nossa sede localizada no coração de Belo Horizonte;
Equipamentos de trabalho: disponibilizamos o principal que você precisa para poder trabalhar com tranquilidade;
Jornada de trabalho flexível: aqui priorizamos entregas de qualidade, e não tempo desprendido;
Cartão de benefício flexível Caju: valores mensais para você usar da forma que quiser (Refeição, alimentação, home office, mobilidade e cultura);
Plano de saúde e odontológico;
Day off de aniversário: tire um dia para curtir e relaxar em até 90 dias após seu aniversário;
Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
Gamificação em nossa plataforma de engajamento: compute netcoins que serão revertidos em prêmios a cada trimestre;
Educalex: benefício de incentivo à educação para a realização de cursos, workshops, palestras, aquisição de livros e mais!

Sobre a oportunidade:
Estruturar e liderar o escritório de gestão de projetos (PMO) da net Lex, garantindo governança, padronização e entrega de valor nos projetos de implantação. O foco desta posição é criar uma operação de projetos eficiente e escalável, traduzindo complexidade operacional em resultados claros para clientes Enterprise e para a alta liderança, enquanto desenvolve uma cultura de projetos orientada a resultados em toda a organização.
Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades como PMO por aqui?
Governança e Padronização Definir e padronizar metodologias de gestão de projetos (Ágil, Tradicional/Preditivo ou Híbrido) em toda a organização. Desenvolver modelos de documentos, relatórios, fluxos de aprovação e ferramentas obrigatórias para os gerentes de projeto. Auditar projetos periodicamente para garantir conformidade com normas e critérios estabelecidos. Monitorar indicadores globais de saúde do portfólio (ROI, desvio de prazo, controle de orçamento). Gestão de Recursos e Riscos Otimizar a alocação de profissionais, equipes e orçamentos entre projetos para evitar gargalos. Identificar e mitigar riscos interdependentes que afetam múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, traçando planos de contingência corporativos. Intervir na resolução de conflitos por recursos entre diferentes departamentos, inclusive organizando a prática de gestão de partes interessadas, envolvendo clientes externos. Desenvolvimento de Pessoas e Cultura Treinar gerentes de projeto e lideranças táticas nas melhores práticas de mercado. Promover uma cultura de eficiência, entrega de valor e foco em resultados por toda a estrutura. Gerenciar, capacitar e motivar a equipe técnica e funcional, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de melhoria contínua.

Certificação PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PMO-CP (PMO Certified Practitioner). Inglês avançado/fluente (projetos globais e atendimento a clientes internacionais). Forte experiência em Gestão de Projetos, PMO ou Liderança, incluindo coordenação de programas, gestão de portfólios múltiplos (PPM) e interface com C-level. Experiência em sistemas no modelo Saa S. Domínio de frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (Waterfall). Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de portfólio (Clarity PPM, Asana Enterprise ou MS Project). Capacidade de Storytelling com Dados
— transformar planilhas complexas em apresentações com narrativa lógica e plano de ação proposto. Vivência em Change Management : análise de impacto cultural, mapeamento de stakeholders e planos de comunicação. Ensino superior completo.
Nossos olhos irão brilhar, se você:
Espanhol avançado/fluente (diferencial para atendimento a clientes Latam). Experiência com ferramentas de BI e criação de dashboards executivos (Power BI ou similares). Experiência em empresas de tecnologia de alto crescimento ou scale-ups.

title: Business specialist
description: Confira esta oportunidade para Business specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. 1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system. 2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal. 3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the proces s. 4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.g., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepanci es. 5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquir ies. 6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.g., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportuni ties.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.
WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB (or another No SQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.
HOW YOU’LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:

The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.
EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.
Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.
Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;
Profile: Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA); Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Data entry specialist
description:

Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you'll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. Position Overview We're looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You'll Do Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity. Who You Are A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U. S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus. Why Join Jones Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class Saa S growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of Saa S operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company. Our culture Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it's in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team's mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Accounting analyst
description:

Specifically, your role will involve:
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.
The ideal profile
We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside Move Up Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:
Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.

A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:
A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with Move Up Media. Third Interview:
A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:
A proposition for us to start working together!
What’s in it for you
Remote Work Environment:
Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:
We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:
As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:
Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun. We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:
€1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.
Move Up Media
We're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of i Gaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords. With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!
Here at Move Up Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a
uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos

exclusiva
para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.
Necessário:
Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta
não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?
Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B )
WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.
IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.
WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB (or another No SQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.
HOW YOU’LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. title: Solutions architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.
Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B) WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM? You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL: Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, Dev Ops, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. WHAT YOU'VE ACCOMPLISHED... SO FAR: 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/Cent OS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of Mongo DB (or another No SQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, Java Script, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders. HOW YOU'LL RAMP: By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Project manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2 B technology.
This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.
About Ten16 Creative Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3 D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.
We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, Saa S, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.
About the Role The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.
This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.
You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.
You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.
You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.
Qualifications The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

Confira esta oportunidade para Coordinador De Planeamiento Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en post de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos.Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa.Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable)Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable).Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable).Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.

title: Analista De Qualidade, Processos E Experiência Do Hóspede
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Qualidade, Processos E Experiência Do Hóspede em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos contratando um(a) Analista de Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede para o Quality Hotel & Suítes São Salvador, 2ª maior complexo hoteleiro em número de apartamentos em Salvador, com 304 UHs, integrante da Atlantica Hotels.Não é uma vaga de manutenção de papelada. É uma vaga de construção.Em hotelaria, Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede não são 3 (três) frentes. São a mesma frente vista de 3 (três) perspectivas. A qualidade é a causa; o processo é o caminho; e a satisfação é o efeito.1. Escutar avaliação, pesquisa, reclamação no balcão2. Responder resposta pública + service recovery3. Classificar tema, setor, gravidade, recorrência4. Converter tema recorrente vira não conformidade5. Corrigir não conformidade vira ação no processo em conjunto com lider da área6. Medir o tema sumiu? a nota subiu?O que você vai fazer: Gestão reputacional do hotel. Análise semântica das avaliações e relatório com os temas positivos e negativos recorrentes, e monitoramento da nota frente aos concorrentes através do ReviewPro, Booking, Google, TripAdvisor — a nota isolada não diz nada; o índice relativo, sim.Ler o que o hóspede escreve, entender o que ele está realmente dizendo, e transformar reclamação recorrente em ação corretiva. Nota não sobe com resposta bonita. Sobe quando o problema para de acontecer. Service recovery: protocolo de recuperação (o que se faz, em quanto tempo, com que alçada), treinamento da Recepção e da Governança. Recuperação feita no check-out vale dez vezes a resposta pública feita depois. Jornada do hóspede: mapear os pontos de contato e cruzar as quebras com os temas recorrentes das avaliações. É onde a jornada encontra o processo. CRM de satisfação: identificar recorrentes no PMS, régua de comunicação, NPS in-house, e integração com o programa de fidelidade da Atlantica — quais deles se hospedam aqui, e como reativar. Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade, manter a ISO 9001 viva. Auditoria interna, não conformidade, plano de ação, preparação para a auditoria externa. Mapear e documentar os processos da Governança, de A&B, de Suprimentos, da Recepção e da Manutenção. Fluxograma, POP, indicador, documentação que as pessoas usam, não a que fica na gaveta. Transformação Digital, em conjunto as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) levar IA e automação para a rotina dos setores. Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Power BI, Clickup, Trello, etc. Não como buzzword: resolvendo o relatório que leva três horas e deveria levar cinco minutos. Construir os processos que a gestão não tem e seus paineis gerenciais, bem como auxiliar as gerencias e o setor de Tecnologia da Informação (TI) a construir soluções integradas.Quem procuramos: Superior completo · 2 a 4 anos em qualidade, processos ou dados · ISO 9001 na prática · Power BI em nível de construção · uso real de IA no trabalho (queremos ver o que você automatizou, não o certificado que você tirou) · escrita clara.O que NÃO procuramos: Alguém que confunda qualidade com burocracia. Se o seu plano é criar mais formulários, esta não é a vaga.Responsabilidades:
- Gerir a reputação nos canais de avaliação (ReviewPro, Booking, Google, TripAdvisor): responder, classificar temas recorrentes e converter reclamação em ação corretiva de processo
- Manter o sistema de gestão da qualidade conforme a ISO 9001: realizar as auditorias internas e acompanhar as auditorias externas, tratamento de não conformidades, plano de ação e preparação para auditoria externa
- Acompanhar o padrão de serviço auditado pela franqueadora e coordenar os planos de ação
- Mapear e documentar os processos operacionais (Governança, A&B, Suprimentos, Recepção, Manutenção): fluxogramas, POPs e indicadores
- Implementar ferramentas de IA e automação nas rotinas administrativas e operacionais (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Power Automate)
- Construir e manter painéis gerenciais em Power BI
- Atuar como interlocutor entre as áreas operacionais e a Tecnologia da InformaçãoRequisitos:
- Ensino superior completo em Hotelaria, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou correlatas
- 2 a 4 anos de experiência em qualidade, processos ou análise de dados
- Conhecimento prático da norma ISO 9001
- Power BI em nível de construção de relatórios
- Uso demonstrável de ferramentas de IA generativa em contexto profissional (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, Power BI, Clickup, Trello, etc).
- Excelente redação em portuguêsDiferenciais:
- Curso de auditor interno ISO 9001
- Experiência em hotelaria, preferencialmente com bandeira nacional ou internacional
- ReviewPro, Revinate ou plataforma equivalente
- BPMN · Power Automate, n8n ou Zapier · Lean/Green Belt · SQL básicoO que oferecemos:
- Autonomia real em um projeto em construção
- Exposição direta à gerência e à diretoria
- Uso de ferramentas de IA de ponta no dia a diaComo se candidatar:Currículo para e com o assunto "Qualidade, Processos e Experiência do Hóspede".Indica alguém? Marca nos comentários #vagas #qualidade #processos #hotelaria #salvador
